// Independent full-width fields prevent GoldenGate from packing all read
  // traffic into a 146-bit multi-port memory. Same asynchronous read and edge.
  val ownerImageMemory = Mem(nSets * nWays, new CacheImageKey)
  val ownerGenerationMemory = Mem(nSets * nWays, UInt(32.W))
  val ownerPacketMemory = Mem(nSets * nWays, UInt(GH_GlobalParams.GH_PACKET_SEQ_BITS.W))
  val ownerTrackedMemory = Mem(nSets * nWays, Bool())
  val ownerMemory = Mem(nSets * nWays, new OwnerPayload)
    val payload = Wire(new OwnerPayload)
    payload.image := ownerImageMemory.read(index)
    payload.generation := ownerGenerationMemory.read(index)
    payload.packetSeq := ownerPacketMemory.read(index)
    payload.tracked := ownerTrackedMemory.read(index)
    Mux(ownerWritten(index), payload, 0.U.asTypeOf(new OwnerPayload))
    Mux(ownerWritten(index), ownerMemory.read(index), 0.U.asTypeOf(new OwnerPayload))
    ownerImageMemory.write(ownerWriteIndex, ownerWriteData.image)
    ownerGenerationMemory.write(ownerWriteIndex, ownerWriteData.generation)
    ownerPacketMemory.write(ownerWriteIndex, ownerWriteData.packetSeq)
    ownerTrackedMemory.write(ownerWriteIndex, ownerWriteData.tracked)
    ownerMemory.write(ownerWriteIndex, ownerWriteData)
